lesson.title: Wonder Thought Experiment
lesson.topic: Exploring reality through thought experiments that challenge our assumptions and expand our wonder about the universe.
lesson.steelman: How can we design a thought experiment that not only questions current scientific understanding but also fosters genuine curiosity and wonder?
lesson.example: Einstein's famous elevator thought experiment to question gravity and introduce the concept of spacetime curvature.

rationale: Encourages critical thinking and imagination to deepen our understanding and appreciation of complex concepts.
